questions.q: How long does the entire process take?
questions.a: Typically 45-60 days. Most of this is waiting for permits and utility approval. Actual installation takes 1-2 days.

questions.q: Do I need to be home for the installation?
questions.a: Yes, we need brief access inside for electrical connections. Most work happens outside on the roof.

questions.q: What happens if it rains on installation day?
questions.a: Safety first. In heavy rain or high winds, we will reschedule. Light rain usually doesn't stop us!

Hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about switching to clean, sustainable solar energy for your home or business.

q1.title: What is the Return on Investment (ROI) for a home system?
q1.answer: ROI typically ranges between 15-25% annually, depending on your local electricity rates and solar incentives. Most homeowners see their system pay for itself within 5 to 7 years. After that point, the energy generated is essentially free for the remaining lifespan of the system.

q2.title: How long do solar panels typically last?
q2.answer: Most modern solar panels are designed to last for 25 to 30 years. However, this doesn't mean they stop working after that period; their efficiency may slightly decrease (usually about 0.5% per year). We offer warranties that guarantee high performance even after 25 years.
